terra.problem: Job’s earlier questions to God are outside this passage and need a reference.
Saying Zophar does not hear a cry for mercy assigns him a perception the text does not give.
The statement that Job was grieving needs a reference to a passage that says so.
The claim that Job said he was weary elsewhere needs a reference.
Nothing gets swept under the rug broadens Zophar’s statement about God seeing and taking note of iniquity beyond what the passage says.
Zophar’s comparison is to a wild donkey’s colt being born a man, not a colt becoming a man.
Saying the staff stays where it is invents a staff in the scene.
People lining up outside the tent adds a detail the passage does not give.
